## Install

1. Download `aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso`, `aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso.sha256`,
   and `aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso.asc` from the assets below.
2. Verify the checksum:
   ```bash
   sha256sum -c aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso.sha256
   ```
3. Verify the GPG signature:
   ```bash
   gpg --verify aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso.asc aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso
   ```
   (Import the AurumOS signing key first: see docs/internal/release-process.md.)
4. Flash to USB:
   ```bash
   sudo dd if=aurumos-v{{VERSION}}.iso of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress conv=fsync
   ```
   Replace `/dev/sdX` with your USB device (NOT a partition).
5. Boot the target machine from the USB and run `aurum-installer`.
